# What will feature flags cost at your requests-per-month volume, and who is cheapest?

> Enter your monthly flag-evaluation volume (thousands of requests) and see what PostHog, Flagsmith and ConfigCat charge, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the volume where the cheapest provider changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
